g.text: Monthly employment at fixed observed ages, by regional THAIE quintile
Sweden, 21 counties, all occupations. The age bands are the actual official groups, not the requested 22–25, 26–30, 31–34, 35–40, 41–49, 50+.
Only regional exposure is observed monthly. All exposures and quintiles use our THAIE; no Stanford/ADP employment or exposure data.
